description: This file defines the interface MetricsConfig in Java, which provides configuration settings for metrics, including enabling system metrics, Prometheus, and related hostname and port configurations, as well as an inner enum for known configuration values.

classes.name: MetricsConfig
classes.description: Interface defining configuration methods for metrics, such as enabling system metrics, Prometheus, and retrieving hostname and port information.

classes.name: MetricsConfig.MetricsConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for MetricsConfig, implementing KnownConfigValue.

methods.name: isSystemMetricsEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether system metrics collection is enabled.

methods.name: isPrometheusEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether Prometheus metrics are enabled.

methods.name: getPrometheusHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname to which the Prometheus HTTP server is bound.

methods.name: getPrometheusPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the Prometheus HTTP server.
